findings.interpretation: The local maximum is real and remains included. Its time overlaps A5 S2-02 context_retrieve/RECENT_TASK with a free-text query and candidate_count30, followed by a bounded five-item receipt. Repeated whole-record string/lower materialization is a plausible shared implementation contribution, inferred from source and temporal evidence; allocation tracing does not prove its exact bytes. The five-repeat maximum cannot establish inherent DP41A memory disadvantage or typical production memory.

limitations.text: Actual semantic HTTP usage at frozen standard prices is measured. Account invoices, physical voice model, physical microphone/ASR, and external Agent internals are not measured. Simulated voice estimates must remain separate.

Mac task_info samples include one isolated worker PID per activity, its HTTP and sampling threads, VIA, local Agent/speech stubs, source buffers, and RAM evidence recorder. They exclude campaign controller, separate post-timing judge/change processes, server RAM and OS desktop. This is a PoC worker scope, not a whole-product process census.

Observed peaks are maxima of sampled TASK_VM_INFO values, not a kernel-maintained all-time peak. The sampler starts after module imports and stops after idle. Between-sample allocations and earlier import-time peaks cannot be recovered. Actual interval/read durations are preserved for every worker.

For the current one-PID runtime, simultaneous process sum equals that PID's observation. No per-process peaks from different times/repeats are added. RSS is mapped resident size and phys_footprint is kernel footprint; neither is Windows commit. For future multi-PID/shared mappings, this sum would not establish unique physical RAM or automatically deduplicate shared pages.

Allocations trace 15 real touched RGBA buffers, the actual serialization copy and 21 materialized canonical original payloads. It is explanatory rather than a complete Python object/alias census. Common buffers/client are shared within each worker; source/owner/context/event snapshots and serialization copies are accounted in OS samples when present. Declared allocation byte counts are never added to OS metrics.

All attempted HTTP costs remain included regardless of semantic adoption or local cancellation. MEANING_DISCARDED has Request/scene provenance, but not a terminal call_id; request-associated calls are disclosed without claiming a unique per-call semantic discard mapping. Frozen synthetic OUTPUT_DISCARDED events do not imply a newly billed voice/model call.

Preparation, judge and change-feature validation ledgers are separate snapshots and excluded from formal VIA mean. They can continue appending after this audit. The complete account spending ledger, including invalidated earlier campaigns/preparation and invoices, is not reconstructed by this QA04/QA06 audit.

The formal terminal ledgers label every actual call purpose=FOREGROUND, including the late-return preparation calls before a scene onset. These formal preparation calls remain in the measured cost and are separately reconstructed from enqueue_ns versus the recorded scene origin. The separate excluded preparation ledgers are readiness preflight, not these formal P21 preparation calls.
